# GetColor <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Drawing](BlitzBasic-Drawing)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetColor:Void x:Int32, y:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the pixel. |
| `y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the pixel. |

## Description

Reads the pixel at a position of the current buffer and makes it the drawing color. Use [ColorRed](ColorRed), [ColorGreen](ColorGreen) and [ColorBlue](ColorBlue) afterwards to see what it was.
